title: Puga
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was R' Yose son of R' Chanina’s attendant, [Bava Batra 90b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.90b.9). Dikdukei Soferim reads Suga; Hyman says [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2940&lang=en) needlessly split him into two people.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara calls him Puga (פוגא), attendant of Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina. Hyman reports Suga from Dikdukei Soferim and criticizes Heilprin for splitting the man into two. [Heilprin’s separate Suga notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2774&lang=en) refers readers back to Puga.
